content.question: What is the key advantage of fastText over word2vec and GloVe?
options: It produces a different vector for each occurrence of a word
It represents words as bags of character n-grams, so rare and out-of-vocabulary words, even misspellings, still get vectors
It requires a smaller vocabulary to be useful
It eliminates the need for a corpus
content.answer: It represents words as bags of character n-grams, so rare and out-of-vocabulary words, even misspellings, still get vectors
